How do they build the fastest tractor in its class? How is the world-famous frankfurter made, and how do they craft wallpaper fit for a king.
How do they build Formula 1 racing cars? How is the Leatherman, America's best-selling multi-tool made? How do they create classic Finnish Aalto glassware.
Drew is at a 900 year old Abbey in Somerset where he hopes to strike a deal. Later, he travels to a pedal museum in East Sussex and takes a trip down memory lane.
Modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard goes for a climb at a 17th century mansion in Cambridge. Later, he visits a massive salvage yard where he encounters a tough negotiator.
Ford Fiesta Supersport And Lotus Elise. The guys are in Dundee to view a Lotus Elise S1. Drew is furious at numerous modifications made to the car, including stickers and a wing.

Drew mixes with aristocracy at a Cornwall estate and finds an amazing collection of classic cars. In Newark, he unearths a hoard of enamel signs for the oil industry.
The Gold Gypsies go on a night-time detecting mission. Shane and Russell push their wash plant to breaking point.
Marcus and Linden suffer an injury that could end their road trip. The Dust Devils attempt to produce the biggest gold pour of the season so far.

Drew and Tee are the first to view a collection in Boreham Wood. Everything is up for sale, including a carved stone saint and marble fireplace supports.
Henry and Fuzz are in Essex to work on restoring Warren's Alpine Sunbeam, hoping to revive it to its original glory and help make it shine once more.
Henry and Fuzz visit Angie and Jon in Bucks and uncover a Francis Barnett and vintage Raleighs. Can they revive them and turn a profit.
Henry and Fuzz visit Ross in Hampshire, where they uncover a Nuffield tractor and sheds packed full of tractors, memorabilia, and more hidden gems.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: In Wiltshire, Henry and Gemma rescue old treasures in a barn. They pick up a coffee table, a footstool, a weaving loom, and a vintage car.
Angus foxtrots into Oti Mabuse's glitzy home and faces a fridge freezer first. And he battles TV presenter Martin Roberts' toy collection.
Angus uncovers a rare coin collection and some vintage hair cutting gear. An old sea chest proves to be a treasure trove at auction.
Natasha and James hit the antiques emporia of the Midlands, discovering tiny shops, little gnomes and a huge specimen of a rather famous bird.
Angus helps a lady sell her parents' belongings and finds treasure with a rare military map. Metal detecting finds and jewellery dazzle on sale day.
Footballer Peter Shilton and actor Ricky Groves trust Angus to sell treasures for charity. They include goalie gloves and James Bond car parts.
Will and Jay work on a historical chair for twin sisters. Plus, Pam visits the barn with a vintage piece that needs the help of mechanical expert, Steve.
How do they make the finest Panama hats? Who rounds up Florida's escaped pythons? How do they keep drivers safe in the world's longest tunnel.
How do they build working miniature airports? How do they design houses to survive hurricanes? How is rhubarb cultivated in the dark.

When Alice Hufnagle is raped and murdered in 2002, police initially question her estranged husband. But, clues eventually lead to her colleague at a local pharmacy.
Sandy Berfield is killed after suffering years of harassment from a co-worker and has him jailed for violating a restraining order. Released, he sends her a bomb.
In 2012, a missing person case in North Dakota alerts investigators. They reveal a scheme involving stolen fracking profits, a ruthless conman and his murderous partner.
Tymeir shines as the loving son, but his brother Rodney's jealousy boils over, driving him to a hideous act of violence that tears their family apart.
An Ohio mother's devotion blinds her to danger. Despite deadly threats, she clings to her violent son, and her love seals the fate she fears most.
When a hardworking mum is shot dead on a sidewalk in 2005, police worked tirelessly to catch the killer. With a murderer on the loose, it was a race against time.
When a DJ is found brutally murdered outside a radio station, police originally believe it was a robbery gone wrong. The truth reveals he was not just a random victim.
A skeleton is discovered on the edge of a high school football field. It takes a forensic sculptor and tireless detective work to finally bring the killer to justice.
A police officer is shot dead in a suspected set-up. Detectives take drastic measures to get answers from a tight-lipped local community.
